condition: resample with a multi-quarter frequency like '2QS-MAR' anchors bins on the nearest single quarter rather than staying in phase with startingMonth, so bins start in the wrong months.
workaround: Set the bin anchor yourself with the origin= argument, or build the bins with pd.date_range starting on the right month and group by them, e.g. pd.date_range("1949-09-01", periods=3, freq="2QS-MAR").
